title: Tuned !
description: Music mod that unlocks new capabilities for making music in Minecraft !
body:
# Tuned !

This mod unlocks new capabilities for making music in Minecraft !

## Features:

### Removes the boundaries of pitch
- Sounds in Minecraft no Longer Need to Fall in the 0.4 to 2.0 Pitch Gap !

### Edo Note Blocks:
- 6 edo
- 7 edo
- 12 edo
- 24 edo
- 29 edo
- 31 edo
- 35 edo
- 41 edo
- 53 edo
- 72 edo

![Edos in version 1.0.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/glCNRy21/images/dbabbda56c6d4a9c89e38ea8dac07b1f74466242.png)

if you want to know more about edo music you can check out a [wiki](https://xenreference.com/w/EDO)

### Commands

- Playsound
Acts Same as the Normal /playsound Command but Removes the Constraints of Pitch
- Ratio to Cents
Converts any ratio to cents
- Ratio to Steps
Converts Ratio in Any Edo to Steps (also acts as notes in note blocks)
